item.title: Inflation Rises 0.2% in January; Annual Rate Falls to 2.4%, Below Forecasts
item.description: Inflation rose 0.2% in January from December, while the annual rate fell to 2.4%, both coming in below expectations. Economists had projected a 0.3% monthly increase and a 2.5% annual rate.

item.title: US, Taiwan Finalize Deal to Cut Tariffs on American Goods
item.description: The US and Taiwan finalize deal to slash tariffs. Taiwan has agreed to eliminate or reduce nearly all tariffs on US goods, while the Trump administration will maintain a 15% tariff on imports from Taiwan.

item.title: IDF Airstrike in Southern Lebanon Kills Hezbollah Terrorist Rebuilding Infrastructure
item.description: The IDF says an airstrike in southern Lebanon last night killed a Hezbollah terrorist working to rebuild the terror group’s military infrastructure.

item.title: Inflation Hits Five-Year Low At 2.4%, Giving Federal Reserve Room to Maneuver
item.description: A key measure of inflation fell to nearly a five-year low last month as apartment rental price growth slowed and gas prices fell, offering some relief to Americans grappling with the sharp cost increases of the past five years. item.title: Trump, Melania Head to Fort Bragg to Honor Forces Behind Maduro Capture
item.description: President Trump and First Lady Melania Trump are heading to Fort Bragg to honor U.S. Special Forces and military families behind Operation Absolute Resolve — the mission that resulted in the capture of Nicolás Maduro.
